name: haven-banking-platform
description: Production-minded full-stack banking platform — separated into frontend, backend and database tiers
//: Intentionally NOT an npm workspace. Each tier owns its package.json and lockfile so Railway can build frontend/ and backend/ independently via Root Directory. These scripts are local-development convenience only.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
